messages:
release-bot: Deploy window: rolling v2 API rollout begins 2026-03-21T22:00Z. SDK pin window = 3h. Canary route = customers:canary-01. Prechecks in runbook: <https://internal/runbooks/v2-rollout>. Ack and run prechecks now pls :rocket:

alex_ryan: ack. I'll validate client SDK pin logic and push a short guide to docs.

maria_g: quick question — is SDK pin default ON for older clients or do we need a server-side header to force pin?

cj_dev: server will emit header `x-client-pin: v1` when we want to pin. SDK reads it and pins for session TTL. Example config to toggle from gateway: ```json
{
  "route": "customers:canary-01",
  "headers": {"x-client-pin": "v1"},
  "pin_ttl_sec": 10800
}
```

julie_pm: rollback criteria we agreed: >1% 5xx across any affected customer or p99 latency regressions >200ms vs baseline for 10m. If hit, immediate traffic shift back to v1 and notify customers. Add to status page.

ops-bot: prechecks done: infra capacity ✅, GPU pool steady, canary infra autoscale set to +20%. Deploy command queued: `/deploy api-gateway v2 --routes customers:canary-01 --pin-ttl 10800`

alex_ryan: added short SDK note to docs and a sample env var `RW_SDK_PIN_STRATEGY=header` — linking: <https://internal/docs/sdk/pinning> 

release-bot: Starting canary now. Will post metrics every 2m. Tagging @maria_g @cj_dev for quick triage during ramp. :eyes:

release-bot: Canary metrics 02m: 0.06% 5xx, p50 +10ms, p99 +35ms. no model-mismatch alerts.

maria_g: seeing a small uptick in client parse errors from one mobile client build (iOS 2.14.0). Investigating whether it's header parsing.

cj_dev: found it — older mobile picks up header value with trailing whitespace and chokes. Pushing a tolerant parser patch to SDK patch branch, but cannot hot patch all clients. Suggest we remove header for that route and keep canary to 10% traffic instead of 30% while we inform mobile team.

julie_pm: agree. Action: reduce canary to 10%, remove `x-client-pin` header for mobile-heavy route `customers:canary-01-mobile`, notify mobile eng + support. I'll draft a short customer note.

ops-bot: traffic updated: customers:canary-01 -> 10% (from 30%). header `x-client-pin` removed on route customers:canary-01-mobile. Changes applied in 60s.

release-bot: Monitoring 10m after change: 5xx down to 0.02%, mobile parse errors back to baseline. p99 stable. Keeping pin window at 3h but will not force header for mobile routes.

alex_ryan: filing follow-up ticket to add whitespace-tolerant header parsing in next SDK roll (ref RW-1284).

julie_pm: good call. I'll update rollout notes and mark this thread for postmortem if any customer impact appears. :white_check_mark:

release-bot: Closing thread — rollout progressing with mitigations. Final status: canary green at reduced weight, no rollback. If anything changes, reopen thread.
